crossRefs.note: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head…
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
I will open rivers on the bare heights, and springs in the middle of the valleys. I will make the wilderness a pool of…

people.name: Negeb
people.line: The southern region of Israel, a semi-arid area

translations.web: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
translations.bsb: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
translations.kjv: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
translations.asv: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
